title: The Production AI Playbook: Deploying Agents at Enterprise Scale — Sandipan Bhaumik, Databricks
talk_summary: Databricks technical lead presents a five-pillar production playbook: evaluation first, tracing/observability, data foundation, multi-agent orchestration, and governance. The concrete mechanisms are golden eval sets, three-layer evals including behavioral tool-call checks, centralized traces, retry/fallback limits, prompt/model change management, and cost-controlled eval suites.

takeaways.what_they_do: Build a golden dataset from real human answers and define numeric success before choosing a model; use that dataset to compare candidate models.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Before touching any code, before discussing about any models, any features, you have to think about when we build this system, how do we measure?
takeaways.numbers: 200 cases; 85% accuracy target; 60% deflection target; model selected in week 7 of an 8-week POC

takeaways.what_they_do: Add a third eval layer that checks tool calls, loops, duplicate calls, and retries, not just final answer quality.
takeaways.numbers: three API calls in the example

takeaways.what_they_do: Use online monitoring to apply fallback strategies and cap retries; after the cap, report or hand off to a human.

takeaways.technique: Subset evals on PR, full suite on merge
takeaways.what_they_do: Run only a small subset of the eval dataset during prompt-change CI, and run the full eval suite only when merging to main.
takeaways.evidence_quote: just selecting a small subset of the eval data set to do the testing. And you only do the full test when you merge to the main branch.

takeaways.what_they_do: Treat prompts as code with versioning and structured commit messages that document the failure being addressed and expected correction.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you need to understand when a prompt was changed, for exact what reason it was changed... What was the failure

takeaways.what_they_do: Re-test model upgrades on the company's own eval dataset instead of relying on vendor benchmarks, and keep models switchable.
takeaways.evidence_quote: try these different models on this evaluation data set and try to understand which one performs better.
